text: Sorry to bother you this late, it's probably nothing. I'm minding my grandson tonight, he's 4 months old, and I think he's got a bit of a temperature. The thermometer said 38.5 but I'm not sure I'm using it right, it's my daughter's one. His eczema has flared up as well, dry itchy patches on his cheeks and in the creases of his arms, and he keeps rubbing at them. I don't know if the two things are connected or if I'm just being an old worrier. Is 38.5 a lot for a baby that small?
